title: Heat Advisory for NYC: today (Thurs, Aug 6) and tomorrow (Fri, Aug 7).
message:
The National Weather Service has issued a Heat Advisory for today, Thursday, August 6, and tomorrow, Friday, August 7. In the most immediate sense, that means cooling centers are open. This includes public pools (yes, Red Hook Pool is included), but they would be open whether there was a heat advisory or not. See below for more info on how to stay appropriately cooled and hydrated.

— Mike Racioppo
codeRedTitle: 🔴 Code Red in effect — Monday, August 10
codeRedBody: During a Code Red, shelter is available to anyone experiencing homelessness, and walk-ins are welcome. Cooling areas are available for anyone experiencing heat-related discomfort. If you are concerned about someone who may need help staying safe in the heat, call 311. Outreach teams are engaging people on the street 24/7.
